beforeEffective.effectiveText: Pruebas que revelan si un tumor tiene roto su sistema de reparación del ADN, lo que predice la respuesta a inhibidores de PARP y platino.
Homologous recombination deficiency means that a template-guided DNA repair process is impaired. A gene finding, a genomic scar and current repair function provide different evidence.
These scores measure selected patterns of accumulated chromosome change. The assay and cutoff matter; a high score alone does not establish current repair failure or treatment eligibility.
RAD51 foci can inform a research assessment of current DNA repair when enough relevant tumour cells and appropriate damage and cycling controls are present.
